title: La fila
goal: Queue, and find out you are in the wrong one
culture: A queue here is not a line, it is an order that everybody in the room is holding in their head. You ask who is last, you tell the next person that you follow them, and then you can go and sit down.

beats.es: (Hay tres filas y ninguna tiene rótulo.)
beats.objective: Ask whether this is the right one
beats.good: Ask before you stand in it for forty minutes. Nothing in the building is labelled and nobody thinks that is strange.

beats.es: No, aquí no. Es en la otra ventanilla.
beats.good: There is always another ventanilla. Being sent to it once is normal; being sent back is Tuesday.

beats.es: (La otra fila no tiene principio ni fin.)
beats.good: This question is how you enter the queue. Somebody puts a hand up, you remember their face, and the order exists.

beats.es: (Llega alguien detrás de usted y pregunta lo mismo.)
beats.good: Yo sigo — I follow. Say it and you can go and sit down, because the room will hold your place for you.
